name: Foundations
tagline: I have an idea but don't know how to build it.
description: The mental model everything else builds on: what software actually is, how projects and files are organized, how to work a terminal, how git remembers history, and how AI coding agents fit in as your implementation partner.
outcome: I can set up a project folder, use git through an AI coding agent, and describe what I want built in words the agent can act on.

name: First Apps
tagline: AI can build a simple app for me.
description: Build complete simple applications: interfaces made of components, state that changes over time, forms, APIs, databases, CRUD operations, and putting the result on the internet with basic deployment.
outcome: I can direct an AI agent to build a working application from my idea, run it locally, and deploy it where other people can use it.

name: Real Apps
tagline: I can give AI structured requirements and review what it builds.
description: Multi-user applications: authentication, authorization, relational databases, validation, automated testing, error handling, logging, roles and permissions - plus the review discipline to verify what the agent built before you trust it.
outcome: I can specify, delegate, review and verify a real multi-user application using a Definition of Done and independent AI-agent verification.

name: Production
tagline: I can make AI build secure production applications.
description: Everything a real product needs under load and with real money: payments, webhooks, background jobs, queues, caching, rate limiting, database indexing, observability, CI/CD, security hardening and failure handling.
outcome: I can understand and direct the engineering decisions required for a production application.

name: Scale & Systems
tagline: I can reason about scalability, reliability and architecture.
description: Complex systems: distributed systems, event-driven architecture, message queues, workers, idempotency, retries, eventual consistency, replication, load balancing, horizontal scaling, fault tolerance and disaster recovery.
outcome: I can use an AI agent to build and reason about complex production systems.

name: AI-Native Apps
tagline: I can build serious AI-powered products.
description: Production AI applications: LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, tool calling, agents, context management, streaming, evaluation, guardrails, prompt injection defense, model costs, latency and AI observability.
outcome: I can build production-grade AI-powered products end to end with AI coding agents.
